<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <androidx.coordinatorlayout.widget.CoordinatorLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@color/background_primary" android:fitsSystemWindows="true">
<!-- Gradient background overlay --> <View android:id="@+id/gradientBackground" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@color/background_primary" />
<ScrollView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:fillViewport="true" android:scrollbars="none">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:paddingHorizontal="16dp" android:paddingTop="16dp" android:paddingBottom="32dp">
<!-- Header con botones de navegación y opciones --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginBottom="32dp">
<ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnBack" android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="Volver" android:src="@drawable/ic_arrow_back" app:tint="@color/text_primary" />
<!-- Centro: título y origen --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:orientation="vertical" android:gravity="center_horizontal" android:layout_marginHorizontal="16dp">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="REPRODUCIENDO DESDE" android:textColor="@color/text_secondary" android:textSize="11sp" android:textStyle="normal" android:textAlignment="center" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvPlayingFrom" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Album Name" android:textColor="@color/text_primary" android:textSize="14sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:textAlignment="center" android:maxLines="1" android:ellipsize="end" android:layout_marginTop="2dp" />
</LinearLayout>
<ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnMore" android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="Más opciones" android:src="@drawable/ic_more_vert" app:tint="@color/text_primary" />
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Imagen del álbum principal --> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginHorizontal="0dp" android:layout_marginBottom="32dp">
<androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" app:cardBackgroundColor="#121212" app:cardCornerRadius="12dp" app:cardElevation="12dp" app:layout_constraintDimensionRatio="1:1" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">
<ImageView android:id="@+id/ivAlbumCover" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:contentDescription="@null" android:scaleType="centerCrop" android:src="@drawable/ic_album_placeholder" />
</androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
<!-- Información de la canción actual --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:orientation="vertical">
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvSongTitle" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Song Title" android:textColor="@color/text_primary" android:textSize="24sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:maxLines="2" android:ellipsize="end" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvArtistName" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Artist Name" android:textColor="@color/text_secondary" android:textSize="18sp" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" android:maxLines="1" android:ellipsize="end" />
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Botón de favoritos --> <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnFavorite" android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="Agregar a favoritos" android:src="@drawable/ic_favorite_border_36" app:tint="@color/text_secondary" android:layout_marginStart="16dp" />
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Barra de progreso --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp">
<!-- Reemplazado SeekBar por Material Slider --> <com.google.android.material.slider.Slider android:id="@+id/seekBarProgress" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="4dp" android:paddingHorizontal="0dp" app:trackSidePadding="0dp" app:thumbRadius="6dp"/>
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal">
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvCurrentTime" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="0:00" android:textColor="@color/text_secondary" android:textSize="12sp" />
<View android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" android:layout_weight="1" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvTotalTime" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="3:24" android:textColor="@color/text_secondary" android:textSize="12sp" />
</LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Controles principales de reproducción --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center" android:layout_marginBottom="4dp">
<!-- Shuffle --> <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnShuffle" android:layout_width="56dp" android:layout_height="56dp" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="Mezclar" android:src="@drawable/ic_shuffle" app:tint="@color/text_secondary" />
<!-- Previous --> <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnPrevious" android:layout_width="56dp" android:layout_height="56dp" android:layout_marginHorizontal="16dp" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="Anterior" android:src="@drawable/ic_skip_next" android:rotation="180" app:tint="@color/text_primary" />
<!-- Play/Pause (botón principal) --> <com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.FloatingActionButton android:id="@+id/btnPlayPause" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginHorizontal="16dp" android:contentDescription="Reproducir/Pausar" android:src="@drawable/ic_play" app:backgroundTint="@color/primary" app:tint="@color/white" app:fabSize="normal" app:maxImageSize="36dp"/>
<!-- Next --> <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnNext" android:layout_width="56dp" android:layout_height="56dp" android:layout_marginHorizontal="16dp" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="Siguiente" android:src="@drawable/ic_skip_next" app:tint="@color/text_primary" />
<!-- Repeat --> <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnRepeat" android:layout_width="56dp" android:layout_height="56dp" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="Repetir" android:src="@drawable/ic_play_arrow" app:tint="@color/text_secondary" />
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Controles adicionales --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" >
<!-- Letras --> <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnLyrics" android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="Letras" android:src="@drawable/ic_lyrics" app:tint="@color/text_secondary" />
<!-- Spacer to push queue to the opposite side --> <View android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" android:layout_weight="1" />
<!-- Cola de reproducción --> <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnQueue" android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="Cola de reproducción" android:src="@drawable/ic_queue_music" app:tint="@color/text_secondary" />
</LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>
</ScrollView>
<!-- Loading state --> <ProgressBar android:id="@+id/progressBar" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_gravity="center" android:visibility="gone" />
</androidx.coordinatorlayout.widget.CoordinatorLayout>

<resources xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"> <!-- Base application theme. --> <style name="Theme.Castafiore" parent="Theme.MaterialComponents.NoActionBar"> <!-- Primary brand color. --> <item name="colorPrimary">@color/primary</item> <item name="colorPrimaryVariant">@color/primary_dark</item> <item name="colorOnPrimary">@color/text_on_primary</item> <!-- Secondary brand color. --> <item name="colorSecondary">@color/secondary</item> <item name="colorSecondaryVariant">@color/secondary_dark</item> <item name="colorOnSecondary">@color/text_on_primary</item> <!-- Status bar color. --> <item name="android:statusBarColor">@color/background_primary</item> <!-- Customize your theme here. --> <!-- Colores de superficie y fondo --> <item name="android:colorBackground">@color/background_primary</item> <item name="colorSurface">@color/surface</item> <item name="colorOnSurface">@color/text_primary</item> <item name="colorSurfaceVariant">@color/surface_variant</item> <item name="colorOnSurfaceVariant">@color/text_secondary</item>
<!-- Colores de error --> <item name="colorError">@color/error</item> <item name="colorOnError">@color/white</item>
<!-- Fondo de ventana --> <item name="android:windowBackground">@color/background_primary</item>
<!-- Colores de texto --> <item name="android:textColorPrimary">@color/text_primary</item> <item name="android:textColorSecondary">@color/text_secondary</item>
<!-- Barra de estado y navegación --> <item name="android:statusBarColor">@color/background_primary</item> <item name="android:navigationBarColor">@color/background_primary</item> <item name="android:windowLightStatusBar">false</item> <item name="android:windowLightNavigationBar">false</item>
<!-- Forzar tema oscuro siempre --> <item name="android:forceDarkAllowed" tools:targetApi="q">false</item>
<!-- Contenedores --> <item name="colorPrimaryContainer">@color/surface</item> <item name="colorOnPrimaryContainer">@color/text_primary</item> <item name="colorSecondaryContainer">@color/surface_variant</item> <item name="colorOnSecondaryContainer">@color/text_primary</item>
<!-- Outline --> <item name="colorOutline">@color/outline</item>
<!-- Control destacado --> <item name="colorControlHighlight">@color/primary_light</item> <item name="colorControlActivated">@color/primary</item> <item name="colorControlNormal">@color/text_secondary</item> </style> </resources>

<resources xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"> <!-- Tema nocturno - Modo oscuro con color principal #FF2D55 --> <style name="Theme.Castafiore" parent="Theme.MaterialComponents.DayNight.NoActionBar"> <!-- Colores primarios --> <item name="colorPrimary">@color/primary</item> <item name="colorPrimaryVariant">@color/primary_dark</item> <item name="colorOnPrimary">@color/text_on_primary</item>
<!-- Colores secundarios --> <item name="colorSecondary">@color/secondary</item> <item name="colorSecondaryVariant">@color/secondary_dark</item> <item name="colorOnSecondary">@color/text_on_primary</item>
<!-- Colores de superficie y fondo para modo oscuro --> <item name="android:colorBackground">@color/background_dark</item> <item name="colorSurface">@color/surface_dark</item> <item name="colorOnSurface">@color/text_on_dark</item> <item name="colorSurfaceVariant">@color/surface_variant_dark</item> <item name="colorOnSurfaceVariant">@color/text_secondary_dark</item>
<!-- Colores de error --> <item name="colorError">@color/error</item> <item name="colorOnError">@color/white</item>
<!-- Fondo de ventana --> <item name="android:windowBackground">@color/background_dark</item>
<!-- Colores de texto para modo oscuro --> <item name="android:textColorPrimary">@color/text_on_dark</item> <item name="android:textColorSecondary">@color/text_secondary_dark</item>
<!-- Barra de estado y navegación para modo oscuro --> <item name="android:statusBarColor">@color/background_dark</item> <item name="android:navigationBarColor">@color/background_dark</item> <item name="android:windowLightStatusBar">false</item> <item name="android:windowLightNavigationBar">false</item>
<!-- Contenedores --> <item name="colorPrimaryContainer">@color/surface_dark</item> <item name="colorOnPrimaryContainer">@color/text_on_dark</item> <item name="colorSecondaryContainer">@color/surface_variant_dark</item> <item name="colorOnSecondaryContainer">@color/text_on_dark</item>
<!-- Outline --> <item name="colorOutline">@color/outline_dark</item>
<!-- Control destacado --> <item name="colorControlHighlight">@color/primary_alpha_12</item> <item name="colorControlActivated">@color/primary</item> <item name="colorControlNormal">@color/text_secondary_dark</item>
<!-- Ripple effect --> <item name="android:colorControlHighlight">@color/ripple</item> </style> </resources>
